subtitle: Per-symbol coverage of the C++ <utility> header. Foundational symbols (swap, move, forward, declval, pair, make_pair) shipped 2026-04-30; tail (exchange, as_const, to_underlying, integer_sequence family, cmp_* + in_range, unreachable, forward_like, in_place_type/in_place_index) shipped 2026-05-09 (Phase 9). Single remaining gap: move_if_noexcept.
legend_blurb: Per-symbol coverage of the C++ <utility> header. Foundational symbols shipped 2026-04-30; tail shipped 2026-05-09 (Phase 9). Single remaining gap: move_if_noexcept (blocked on is_copy_constructible).

symbols.name: swap
symbols.notes: Three-tier impl: C++14+ constexpr move-based, C++11 move-based, C++98 copy-based. Conditional noexcept gated on variadic templates.

symbols.name: swap (array overload)
symbols.notes: Element-wise swap on T[N]. Unqualified noexcept pending is_nothrow_swappable (C++17).

symbols.name: move
symbols.notes: Single-statement static_cast to remove_reference<T>::type&&. constexpr-eligible on C++11.

symbols.name: forward
symbols.notes: Two overloads (lvalue / rvalue). Rvalue overload static_asserts against forwarding rvalue as lvalue.

symbols.name: declval
symbols.notes: Declared-only. Return type via add_rvalue_reference, so declval<void>() yields void.

symbols.name: pair
symbols.notes: Member-init-list ctors are constexpr on C++11+. Move ctor noexcept-conditional on is_nothrow_move_constructible (variadic-gated).

symbols.name: operator== (pair)
symbols.notes: Lexicographic equality. constexpr in restd from C++11.

symbols.name: operator!= (pair)
symbols.notes: Defined as !(==). Synthesised from op== since C++20.

symbols.name: operator< (pair)
symbols.notes: Lexicographic less-than. Implemented in terms of < only.

symbols.name: operator<= (pair)
symbols.notes: Defined as !(rhs < lhs). Synthesised from <=> since C++20.

symbols.name: operator> (pair)
symbols.notes: Defined as rhs < lhs. Synthesised from <=> since C++20.

symbols.name: operator>= (pair)
symbols.notes: Defined as !(lhs < rhs). Synthesised from <=> since C++20.

symbols.name: swap (pair)
symbols.notes: Member and non-member overloads. Member-wise via restd::swap. Unqualified noexcept pending is_nothrow_swappable.

symbols.name: make_pair
symbols.notes: C++11+ uses perfect forwarding with restd::decay; C++98 uses pass-by-value. reference_wrapper unwrap pending restd::reference_wrapper.

symbols.name: piecewise_construct_t
symbols.notes: Tag type. Pending restd::tuple.
symbols.failure_reason: Pending restd::tuple -- piecewise_construct overload of pair takes two tuples of forwarded args.

symbols.name: piecewise_construct
symbols.notes: Tag constant. Pending restd::tuple.

symbols.name: tuple_size<pair>
symbols.notes: Specialisation shipped 2026-05-17 in utility/pair_tuple_size.hpp. tuple_size<pair<T1, T2>>::value == 2. The cv-qualified passthrough specialisations on tuple_size pick up cv-qualified pairs automatically (LWG 2762).

symbols.name: tuple_element<I,pair>
symbols.notes: Specialisations shipped 2026-05-17 in utility/pair_tuple_element.hpp. tuple_element<0, pair<T1,T2>>::type == T1, tuple_element<1, pair<T1,T2>>::type == T2. Indices outside {0,1} are SFINAE-rejected.

symbols.name: get<I>(pair)
symbols.notes: Index-based access shipped 2026-05-17 in utility/pair_get.hpp. Four value-category overloads (lvalue, const lvalue, rvalue, const rvalue) dispatched through an internal pair_get_helper<I> tag-dispatch specialised on I in {0,1}.

symbols.name: get<T>(pair)
symbols.notes: Type-based access shipped 2026-05-17 in utility/pair_get.hpp. Eight overloads (4 categories × 2 element positions) SFINAE-restricted via enable_if on is_same<_T,_T1>/is_same<_T,_T2> AND NOT is_same<_T1,_T2> (uniqueness requirement). Returns the matching element by reference of the appropriate category.

symbols.name: operator<=> (pair)
symbols.notes: Shipped 2026-05-17 in utility/pair_compare_three_way.hpp. Two-step lexicographic three-way comparison written inline (pair has fixed arity 2 — no recursive helper needed). Result type is common_comparison_category_t over the two per-element <=> result types. Each per-element <=> result is static_cast'd to the common type before comparison-vs-0 and return.

symbols.name: exchange
symbols.notes: Replace value, return old. Uses move + perfect-forwarding. constexpr on C++14+ via D_CONSTEXPR_CPP14. Header gated on rvalue refs (C++11+); a copy-based C++98 form would compile but defeat the purpose, so not provided.

symbols.name: as_const
symbols.notes: Returns const T&. Includes the deleted rvalue overload to prevent binding a const& to a temporary that escapes the full-expression lifetime.

symbols.name: in_place_type_t<T>
symbols.notes: Type-tagged variant of in_place. Class template; used by variant for unambiguous type-disambiguated overload selection.

symbols.name: in_place_type<T>
symbols.notes: Tag template variable. Gated on D_ENV_CPP_FEATURE_LANG_VARIABLE_TEMPLATES (C++14+).

symbols.name: in_place_index_t<I>
symbols.notes: Index-tagged variant of in_place. Class template; used by variant for index-disambiguated overload selection.

symbols.name: in_place_index<I>
symbols.notes: Tag template variable. Gated on D_ENV_CPP_FEATURE_LANG_VARIABLE_TEMPLATES (C++14+).

symbols.name: integer_sequence<T,Is...>
symbols.notes: Compile-time integer pack. value_type and ::size() exposed per std contract. Foundational for tuple_cat, apply, etc.

symbols.name: index_sequence<Is...>
symbols.notes: Alias for integer_sequence<size_t, ...>. Gated on alias-templates feature macro (C++11 has them).

symbols.name: make_integer_sequence<T,N>
symbols.notes: Dual path: builtin (O(1) instantiation depth) when available; recursive fallback otherwise. Recursive fallback caps around N=512 (gcc default depth). Documented limit; consumers needing big sequences on a fallback compiler should split work or bump -ftemplate-depth.

symbols.name: make_index_sequence<N>
symbols.notes: Generator alias = make_integer_sequence<size_t, N>.

symbols.name: index_sequence_for<Ts...>
symbols.notes: Alias for make_index_sequence<sizeof...(Ts)>. The most-used form in practice (unpacking variadic packs).

symbols.name: move_if_noexcept
symbols.notes: Casts to const T& if T's move can throw and copy is available, else to T&&.

symbols.name: forward_like
symbols.notes: Propagates the const-ness and value category of T to U. Used in deducing-this methods and lambdas with explicit object parameters. Six type rules verified via static_assert in test 16: T=lvalue/rvalue/non-ref crossed with const/non-const. Helpers internal::cond_const + cond_ref pick the right qualifier.

symbols.name: to_underlying
symbols.notes: static_cast<underlying_type_t<E>>(e). Gated on D_RESTD_HAS_UNDERLYING_TYPE (the __underlying_type intrinsic) - inherits the same gating as the underlying_type trait itself.

symbols.name: cmp_equal
symbols.notes: Sign-aware integer comparison. Dispatches on (signedness-of-T, signedness-of-U) cartesian product via partial specialisations of internal::intcmp_eq. Verified against the famous trap: cmp_equal(int(-1), unsigned(-1)) returns false (mathematically correct).

symbols.name: cmp_not_equal
symbols.notes: Defined as !cmp_equal(t, u).

symbols.name: cmp_less
symbols.notes: Sign-aware integer less-than. Verified against the famous trap: cmp_less(int(-1), unsigned(0)) returns true (mathematically correct, vs. native operator< which returns false after promotion to unsigned).

symbols.name: cmp_greater
symbols.notes: Defined as cmp_less(u, t).

symbols.name: cmp_less_equal
symbols.notes: Defined as !cmp_less(u, t).

symbols.name: cmp_greater_equal
symbols.notes: Defined as !cmp_less(t, u).

symbols.name: in_range<R>(t)
symbols.notes: Range-checked integer fit: cmp_greater_equal(t, R::min) && cmp_less_equal(t, R::max). Built on the cmp_* primitives so the same sign-safety holds.

symbols.name: unreachable
symbols.notes: [[noreturn]] hint that this point cannot be reached. Compiler intrinsic preferred; falls back to std::abort() on unknown compilers. Note: std contract says UB if reached, but a defined abort is strictly safer than silent miscompilation - documented intentional deviation.
